body.prompt: GRANDMA (now): the same Korean grandma, now in her eighties, snow-white hair in a low bun, deeper smile wrinkles, the same indigo quilted vest, a little more bent. Now, a snowy winter afternoon. The grandma, alone, stands beside the snowy jangdokdae with her hands tucked into her sleeves; on the closed lid of one earthenware crock, one single glossy red persimmon rests on a small white dish beside the brass spoon. The persimmon tree is bare. She looks toward the closed wooden gate with quiet longing. Only the grandma in the frame.
